primaryChecks.text: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.

context.text: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.
The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward.

context.text: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.
The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.’”
